title: My Journey in Education and Technology
intro: Hi, I'm Patrick Flynn. My career has always revolved around two passions: helping schools use technology strategically and creating engaging, meaningful learning experiences for students in international settings.

sections.heading: International Teaching Journey
sections.content: My international teaching journey began in 2013 after completing my CELTA in Hanoi. Since then, Vietnam has been my professional and personal home, offering opportunities that have shaped me as both an educator and a leader. I've committed myself to continuous professional development and to finding ways my skills can support innovative, future-focused school communities.

sections.heading: Bridging Technology and Education
sections.content: I've been passionate about technology since I was young, whether it was programming or tinkering with Raspberry Pis. That curiosity eventually led me to earn a First-Class Honours Higher Diploma in Software Development. While my years as a developer and tester were valuable, I discovered my real interest lies at the intersection of technology and teaching.
sections.additionalParagraph: In 2019, after earning my UK QTS through Moreland University, I transitioned into international teaching, specialising in Computer Science. Since then, I've developed curricula across KS3 to IBDP and taken on whole-school EdTech leadership roles. Along the way, I've continued to sharpen my skills, completing the Google Project Management Certificate (2024) and becoming a Microsoft Certified Educator (2025). These achievements reflect my commitment to data-driven EdTech strategy and implementing technology solutions that save schools significant resources - including a strategic hardware selection process that saved over $18,500. I've also pioneered innovative programs like the Student Tech Ambassador initiative to build sustainable, peer-led support systems. Looking ahead, I'm excited to apply my experience in leadership and teaching across diverse international schools, particularly in Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.

sections.heading: Personal Life and Values

familyPhoto.alt: Patrick Flynn with his wife and two children.
familyPhoto.caption: My family and I value international experiences and cultural immersion.

sections.content: Family is at the heart of everything I do. My wife, originally from Vietnam, works as a Regional Systems Manager for the International Schools Partnership (ISP), and we share a deep connection to both technology and international education. Together, we're raising our two children, Aisling Chi (5) and Cian Son (2), with the belief that exposure to different cultures is one of the greatest gifts we can give them.
sections.additionalParagraph: Living abroad has also shaped my values. Becoming fluent in Vietnamese has not only enriched my daily life but also reinforced my commitment to cultural immersion and adaptability, qualities I bring to my professional work in diverse school communities.

sections.heading: Beyond the Classroom
sections.content: Outside of school, I'm passionate about staying active and involved. I spend time in the gym, cycle regularly, and have coached JV and Varsity football teams at BIS Hanoi. I also hold GAA coaching certificates from Ireland, and I love contributing to extracurricular life wherever I teach. Music is another outlet. I play guitar and bass, and I've always enjoyed being part of student and teacher bands. And as a lifelong Newcastle United supporter, I know the highs and lows of perseverance all too well! A few years ago, I also had the privilege of walking the Camino de Santiago, an experience that combined both endurance and reflection.

sections.conclusion: My diverse background, international outlook, and commitment to lifelong learning shape my collaborative, student-focused approach to EdTech leadership. I'm always eager to explore how innovative practices can enhance education and enrich school communities.
